{{Quote|Queen Jamillia's asked me to mediate a dispute between Naboo's Artisans' Guild and the Bonadan Silver Sand Consortium. They've raised their prices again, and the glassblowers are about ready to declare war.|Padmé Amidala, to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]]|<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />}}
The '''Artisans' Guild''' was a guild of glassblowers that was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Artisans' Guild became embroiled in a trade dispute after they objected to a rise in prices by the [[Silver Sand Consortium]]. In an attempt to resolve the contention, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] asked [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to negotiate a resolution to the crisis.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Siege" />
